ruling: - **R33. Every role has a chosen model and effort, with a reason.** Owner 11:09 CST Nov 11: "i do think these roles that have defaults need to have decided models and why -- similarly maybe an evaluation of what else can be a first try haiku vs what needs to go higher and at what effort levels". Rows in the model table that no ruling chose today: main session, coordinator, triage, batch runner (through "separate sessions"), general-purpose agents, and every skill. Each gets a model, an effort and a one-line reason. An evaluation then tests each role on the cheapest model that passes its checks. It reads measured outcomes per role and model: review pass rates, fix rounds, builder third tries, and cost from R32's audit. Known data: Haiku round 1 fails 79% of reviews, Sonnet 38% (R9; the share that is noise is unknown). A row moves only on a measured pass rate. A move above Sonnet needs the owner's grant (rule roles-sonnet-is-the-ceiling). Runs after R32's audit, and folds in docs/todo.md line 9 (roadmap step c201: one lane per role on the next model down) and debt lane-model-recheck (whether any lane should run Opus). Home: decision agent-model-cap. Owner 13:52 CST Nov 11: "i'd say all three stay on opus for now until 3.7": the coordinator, triage and the batch runner respawn on Opus at the fresh start.
